name: Peninsula
description: The central peninsula packed with high-rise apartments, the yacht harbor, restaurants and shops, flanked by calm Mansa and wild Brava waters. It is the walkable core of Punta del Este with the most services, dining and year-round activity.
bestFor: Travellers wanting a walkable central base with beaches, dining and the marina

name: Playa Mansa
description: The calm-water side facing the bay, lined with apartment towers, hotels and quieter beaches ideal for swimming and sunsets. More sheltered than the ocean side, it suits those wanting relaxed beach access close to the peninsula's amenities.
bestFor: Visitors wanting calm swimmable beaches and sunsets near central amenities

name: Playa Brava
tagline: Wild ocean side with iconic sculpture
description: The Atlantic-facing surf side, home to the famous Los Dedos hand sculpture and strong waves. Lined with residences and beach clubs, it draws surfers and those wanting dramatic open-ocean beaches within easy reach of the peninsula.
bestFor: Surfers and beach lovers wanting open ocean and the iconic sculpture

name: La Barra
description: A trendy former fishing village east of Punta, known for its wavy bridge, art galleries, boutiques and buzzing summer nightlife. More relaxed and creative than the peninsula, La Barra attracts a stylish crowd and long-stay visitors seeking character.
bestFor: Nomads wanting a creative coastal village with galleries, dining and nightlife
